measurement_boundaries.primary_calls: Backend invocation through backend return; excludes result destruction, collection, buffer retirement, and allocator reset.
measurement_boundaries.primary_cleanup: Result destruction followed by collection, buffer retirement, and allocator reset made necessary by that invocation.
measurement_boundaries.high_frequency_call_latency: Each backend invocation through backend return; excludes per-call cleanup.
measurement_boundaries.high_frequency_cleanup_inclusive_through: Per-backend invocation and cleanup totals, including result destruction and reclamation when outputs are not reused.
measurement_boundaries.diagnostics: Each summary uses diagnostic_iterations samples. Component metrics are nested within and overlap their associated invocation; they must not be added to derive end-to-end time. Uncached and cached invocation metrics come from separate, equally sized sample populations.

comparison_contract.local: In-process public PyTorch operation, including its ordinary Python dispatch, output allocation, and numerical kernel.
comparison_contract.bundled: In-process bundled plugin operation using the same transport-neutral C++ kernel as the reference worker, without rings or shared-memory transport.
comparison_contract.isolated: Python frontend binding and planning, runtime-owned shared outputs, native handoff, command/completion rings, worker dispatch, and the same transport-neutral C++ kernel.

frontend_python.boundary: Direct timers around scalar binding and schema output-expression evaluation. Other Python bookkeeping remains included in isolated call latency and is not inferred by subtracting overlapping timers.

ring_control.boundary: Ring ping is independent. Submission queue, publication/backpressure, worker wakeup/queue, completion wakeup, and caller materialization are measured at their owning ring boundary.

startup_control.boundary: Fixed control ping measures startup/liveness control separately.

mapping_transport.boundary: Input sharing, FD transfer and mmap, cached mapping checks, and worker tensor-view construction; first-use and cached samples are separate.

allocation.boundary: Runtime-owned cold, pooled, and per-output allocation service. Output service is an envelope that includes its allocation and mapping work.

reclamation.boundary: Post-return collection, worker recipient retirement, and buffer reset; excluded from primary call latency.

profiling_cost.boundary: Paired direct and opt-in profiled invocations use the same cached inputs; both stop at backend return and are reported independently.
